title: Book about Lucid and Shared Dreams (and how to have them)
content: There's a whole chapter devoted to shared dreaming in [this book Active Dreaming](https://www.amazon.com/Active-Dreaming-Journeying-Self-Limitation-Freedom/dp/1577319648/ref=sr_1_1?keywords=active+dreaming&qid=1668710417&sr=8-1) by Robert Moss. I thought this community might be interested. Besides how to have shared dreams, the book goes over how to have more lucid dreams and how to bring guidance from the dreamworld, and other stuff like that.
